description: Finds the event a rider is training for, from what they say in their own words: a name ("the Mallorca 312") or an idea ("a gravel event in Spain in May", "a 100 km sportive near Leeds this summer"). Turn what they said into the fields you can; leave the rest out. Searches Etapa's events, and the web for a name Etapa doesn't list. Talk the matches over with the rider, one question at a time, before using one. Call again with what they add. Needs the rider signed in.

country.description: Country as a two-letter code (ES, GB, FR, US…)

discipline.description: The kind of event, if they said: sportive, gravel, mtb, charity, triathlon, duathlon

from.description: Earliest date they'd ride it, YYYY-MM-DD (start of a month they named)

name.description: The event's name or part of it, as the rider said it ("Mallorca 312", "Dragon Ride")

place.description: A town or area, if they named one

to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD (end of a month or season they named)

name: etapa_find_event
title: Etapa: find the rider's event
